# EELA by Empowr

> EELA (by Empowr) is a session discovery and membership platform connecting people with learning and development opportunities in their community.

EELA helps adults and young people find, book, and track participation in programmes run by Empowr CIC — including adult skills sessions, children's activities, and community events. It makes Empowr's programme offering navigable and accessible in one place.

## Sections

- [Home](https://eela.empowrcic.org): Overview of EELA and featured programmes
- [Adults](https://eela.empowrcic.org/adults): Skills development and learning sessions for adults
- [Kids Space](https://eela.empowrcic.org/kids): Activities and programmes for children and young people

## About

EELA is operated by Empowr CIC (empowrcic.org), a UK-based Community Interest Company. All programmes listed on EELA are delivered or curated by Empowr CIC.

## Contact

- Website: https://eela.empowrcic.org
- Parent organisation: https://empowrcic.org
